title: Russia-Ukraine war: Grain hub attacks raise fears over global food prices
summary: Kyiv and Moscow have been trading attacks on each other's grain warehouses, as concerns mount that global food prices could rise as a result. Russia struck Ukraine's largest grain shipment port on the Danube overnight, causing damage and setting off a fire.
